## Andrei Akimov

I am an independent researcher in earthquake seismology with more
than 25 years of experience in seismic data processing, real-time
earthquake systems, and scientific software development.

I hold a Master's degree in Applied Mathematics. My current interests
include earthquake location, phase association, P-wave polarization,
waveform analysis, virtual arrays, and observations of Earth's inner
core.

I am open to short- and long-term projects and research collaborations.
